word: Word 16.114, compat 14 and 15 alike: a line breaks after a space, '-', U+2010, U+2013, U+2014 and after 、。，
no break after / ? ! } | or a bare U+00AD when a letter follows (UAX-14 allows these): the whole token moves
no break after , . : ; ) ] % & + = _ ~ * @ # ' ’ " U+2011 U+00A0 either

knownDifferences.U+00AD: Word keeps a bare U+00AD unbroken; the engine carries w:softHyphen as U+00AD and must break there, so it keeps the break
